boundedQuestion: Can several generated views be admitted as one 3D teacher without a persistent appendage identity ledger across all views?

sourceSet.name: coconut-crab-generated-four-view-set-2026-09-30
sourceSet.userCorrection: Appendage count is wrong and would produce a severely incorrect model.

decisionRules: Every view must account for every locked appendageId.
VISIBLE and OCCLUDED preserve topology identity; CROPPED and UNKNOWN hold coverage.
Missing, extra, duplicated, side-swapped, role-drifted, attachment-drifted, or segment-count-drifted records hold topology.
A user-rejected source set is not eligible for model generation even if a synthetic contract replay passes.
Generated views never become biological Canonical Truth without an independent real-source Observation Root.
